name: White Matter Mask
summary: Creates a binary white matter mask from a FreeSurfer subject's aparc+aseg.mgz segmentation using mri_convert and MATLAB/vistasoft.
description: Converts FreeSurfer's aparc+aseg.mgz to RAS-oriented NIfTI and sets to 1 the voxels of a fixed list of FreeSurfer labels (cerebral and cerebellar white matter, corpus callosum, brainstem, thalamus, basal ganglia, ventral diencephalon and related structures), 0 elsewhere. Use it to get a white matter mask, for example for tractography seeding or masking. It needs a completed FreeSurfer recon-all output and runs with MATLAB, vistasoft and FreeSurfer on the host (no container).

outputs.description: Binary white matter mask (mask.nii.gz) in the space of the FreeSurfer volume, RAS orientation; includes subcortical labels listed in make_wm_mask.m.
